title: Potato & Leek Soup
description: Potato & Leek Soup is a classic Continental soup featuring sweet leeks, tender potatoes, and a rich, velvety broth finished with milk and cream. Smooth, elegant, and comforting, it is ideal as a refined starter served with crispy leek garnish and fresh chives.

ingredients.title: For the Soup Base
items: Leeks (white and light green parts only), finely sliced and washed – 500 g
Floury potatoes (Yukon Gold / Maris Piper / Desiree), peeled and diced – 400 g
Chicken stock or vegetable stock – 1 L

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Finely snipped chives or chive batons
Crispy fried leek julienne or potato strings
Herb oil or truffle oil – a light drizzle (optional)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Sweat the Aromatics
steps: Heat the butter and olive oil in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over low heat.
Add the chopped onion and sliced leeks with a pinch of salt.
Cook gently for 8–10 minutes until softened without allowing any colour to develop.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Build the Soup
steps: Add the diced potatoes, bay leaf, and thyme.
Stir well to coat the vegetables in the butter mixture.
Pour in the hot stock and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 20–25 minutes until the potatoes are completely tender.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Blend the Soup
steps: Remove the bay leaf and thyme sprigs.
Blend the soup using a high-speed blender or immersion blender until completely smooth.
For an ultra-silky finish, strain through a fine chinois or muslin cloth.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish the Soup
steps: Return the soup to the saucepan over low heat.
Stir in the milk and gently reheat without boiling.
Add the cream if using.
Season with fine sea salt and freshly ground white pepper.
Adjust the consistency with a little extra warm stock or milk if required.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Presentation
steps: Ladle the hot soup into pre-warmed shallow bowls.
Garnish with crispy fried leek julienne or potato strings.
Sprinkle with finely snipped chives.
Finish with a drizzle of herb oil or truffle oil and garnish with microgreens if desired.
Serve immediately.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with warm artisan sourdough and cultured butter.
Pair with Gruyère gougères or Parmesan crisps for an elegant starter.
Garnish with crispy leek, fresh chives, and a drizzle of herb or truffle oil for a fine dining presentation.

chefTips: Sweat the leeks gently without browning to preserve their delicate sweetness and colour.
Use a high-quality stock for the best depth of flavour.
Blend while the soup is still hot and strain through a fine chinois for a silky-smooth texture.
Do not boil after adding the milk and cream to prevent splitting.
The soup base can be prepared in advance; add the milk, cream, and garnishes just before serving.
